missions.title: Torrent Breaker
missions.description: Just a few months ago, I would never have thought I'd be here, facing circumstances such as these...

missions.title: Electronic Eye
missions.description: To find our target informant, we have come to this unfamiliar city and commenced a low-profile hacking operation.

missions.title: Silent Pursuit
missions.description: While we were trawling through the records, a civilian Doll dressed as a maid caught our eye. In fact, not just ours...

missions.title: Prior to Destruction
missions.description: We're running out of time! Her neural cloud is about to... This is our last hope! We mustn't -

missions.title: House in the Street
missions.description: Following instructions, we arrived at our destination - the hiding place of our informant. I hope we aren't too late, but things aren't looking good...

missions.title: Underworld
missions.description: After extensive investigation, we have confirmed that the informant has been brought...underground. That will be where this mission ends.

missions.title: Strange Journey
missions.description: To find out Ange's whereabouts, the Commander has led us to the train station. We'll be taking the train bound for Belgrade, where we are to find the only person with this information.

missions.title: Plan of Attack
missions.description: We have confirmed the informant's location. All that's left is to seize the outpost and rescue our target. But first, we must prepare.

missions.title: Fishing in Troubled Waters
missions.description: The preparation is complete. A huge commotion has been created so that we can take over the control room. Now let's finally storm this outpost in the sewers!

missions.title: Great Escape
missions.description: Just a few months ago, I would never have thought I'd be here, facing circumstances such as these, with our faith...placed entirely on...
